question.text: If p : It raining today, $\mathrm{q}:$ I go to school, r : I shall meet any friends and s : I shall go for a movie, then which of the following is the proposition : 'If it does not rain or if I do not go to school, then I shall meet my friend and go for a movie'?

solution.text:
Correct result is $(\sim \mathrm{p} \vee \sim \mathrm{q}) \Rightarrow(\mathrm{r} \wedge \mathrm{s})$
So, $\sim(p \wedge q) \Rightarrow(r \wedge s)$
